title: Lack of Authentication or Authorization on App Components
requirement: The app enforces authentication and authorization on its components.

title: Lack of Auto-fill Support for Credential Providers
requirement: The app enables auto-fill support for credential providers.

title: Local Authentication Can Be Bypassed
requirement: The app implements local authentication securely.

title: Fallback to Non-biometric Credentials Allowed for Sensitive Transactions
requirement: The app does not allow fallback to non-biometric credentials for sensitive transactions.

title: Crypto Keys Not Invalidated on New Biometric Enrollment
requirement: The app invalidates keys after any enrollment of new biometric data.

title: Step-Up Authentication Not Implemented for Sensitive Actions
requirement: The app enforces step-up authentication before granting access to sensitive functionality.

title: Sensitive Data Accessible After Session Termination
requirement: The app makes sensitive data inaccessible after session termination.

title: Lack of Non-Repudiation for Critical Actions
requirement: The app ensures non-repudiation for critical actions.

title: Running on a Recent Platform Version Not Ensured
requirement: The app detects if it is running on an unsupported OS version and reacts appropriately.

title: Latest Platform Version Not Targeted
requirement: The app targets the latest platform version.

title: Enforced Updating Not Implemented
requirement: The app detects if it must be updated and reacts appropriately.

title: Dependencies with Known Vulnerabilities
requirement: The app's third-party components are regularly checked for known vulnerabilities.

title: Compiler-Provided Security Features Not Used
requirement: The app uses the compiler-provided security features of the platform.

title: Use of Deprecated APIs or Functionality
requirement: The app does not use deprecated APIs or functionality.

title: Using Non-Standard APIs for Security-Critical Functionality
requirement: The app uses standard APIs for security-critical functionality.

title: Malicious Code Included in the App
requirement: The app package does not contain malicious code.

title: Unsafe Dynamic Code Loading
requirement: The app loads dynamic code safely from trusted sources.

title: Unsafe Handling of Untrusted Data
requirement: The app securely handles untrusted data.

title: Improper Encryption
requirement: The app properly encrypts sensitive data.

title: Improper Hashing
requirement: The app properly hashes sensitive data.

title: Improper Use of Message Authentication Code (MAC)
requirement: The app properly uses Message Authentication Codes (MACs).

title: Improper Generation of Cryptographic Signatures
requirement: The app properly generates cryptographic signatures.

title: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature
requirement: The app properly verifies cryptographic signatures.

title: Improper Random Number Generation
requirement: The app properly generates random numbers.

title: Improper Cryptographic Key Generation
requirement: The app securely generates cryptographic keys.

title: Improper Cryptographic Key Derivation
requirement: The app derives cryptographic keys using approved key derivation functions.

title: Cryptographic Key Rotation Not Implemented
requirement: The app rotates cryptographic keys regularly.

title: Cryptographic Key Access Not Restricted
requirement: The app restricts access to cryptographic keys.

title: Device Secure Lock Not Enforced
requirement: The app verifies that the device has a secure lock configured.

title: Network Traffic Not Encrypted
requirement: The app encrypts all network traffic.

title: Insecure Certificate Validation
requirement: The app validates certificates for all network traffic.

title: Insecure Identity Pinning
requirement: The app correctly implements identity pinning.

title: Insecure Deep Links
requirement: The app securely handles deep links.

title: Improper Use of the Clipboard
requirement: The app uses the clipboard securely and only with user consent.

title: Insecure Intents
requirement: The app securely handles intents.

title: Sensitive Native Functionality Exposed in WebViews
requirement: The app does not expose sensitive native functionality to WebView content.

title: WebViews Allow Access to Local Resources with Untrusted Content
requirement: The app only allows trusted WebView content to access local resources.

title: WebViews Loading Untrusted Content
requirement: The app only allows trusted content in WebViews.

title: Unnecessary Exposure of Sensitive Data via the User Interface
requirement: The app does not unnecessarily expose sensitive data through its user interface.

title: Unnecessary Exposure of Sensitive Data via Notifications
requirement: The app does not unnecessarily expose sensitive data through system notifications.

title: Insufficient Protection of Sensitive Data from Screenshots or Screen Recordings
requirement: The app removes or masks sensitive data from its views when moved to the background, when being recorded or when a screenshot is taken.

title: App Vulnerable to Overlay Attacks
requirement: The app protects its sensitive screens against overlay attacks.

title: Sensitive Data Leaked via Accessibility Services
requirement: The app prevents sensitive data from being exposed to, or captured by, accessibility services.

title: Inadequate Permission Management
requirement: The app adequately manages permissions.

title: Lack of Anonymization or Pseudonymisation Measures
requirement: The app uses anonymization or pseudonymisation measures.

title: Incorrect Use of Identifiers for User Tracking
requirement: The app does not use persistent or unique identifiers in a way that enables user tracking.

title: Usage of Non-Privacy-Preserving Functionality
requirement: The app uses privacy-preserving functionality.

title: Inadequate Awareness for Privacy Relevant Actions
requirement: The app informs the user about the privacy implications before performing an action.

title: Inadequate Defaults for Privacy Relevant Actions
requirement: The app uses adequate defaults for privacy relevant actions.

title: Inadequate Privacy Policy
requirement: The app provides an adequate privacy policy.

title: Inadequate Data Collection Declarations
requirement: The app adequately declares all user collected data.

title: Inadequate Tracking Domains Declarations
requirement: The app adequately declares all tracking domains it connects to.

title: Non-Reproducible Builds
requirement: The app offers reproducible builds.

title: Lack of Proper Data Management Controls
requirement: The app provides adequate controls to manage user data.

title: Inadequate Data Visibility Controls
requirement: The app provides adequate controls over the visibility of user data.

title: Inadequate or Ambiguous User Consent Mechanisms
requirement: The app requests user consent prior to any data processing.

title: Root/Jailbreak Detection Not Implemented
requirement: The app detects if it runs on a rooted/jailbroken device and reacts appropriately.

title: App Virtualization Environment Detection Not Implemented
requirement: The app detects when it is running inside an app-virtualization environment.

title: Emulated or Virtual Device Detection Not Implemented
requirement: The app detects when it is running in an emulated or virtual device environment.

title: Device Attestation Not Implemented
requirement: The app implements device attestation.

title: Malware Detection Not Implemented
requirement: The app detects attacks by malware.

title: App Attestation Not Implemented
requirement: The app implements app attestation.

title: App Resources Integrity Not Verified
requirement: The app verifies the integrity of its resources.

title: Runtime Code Integrity Not Verified
requirement: The app detects unauthorized changes to its code and execution flow at runtime.

title: Code Obfuscation Not Implemented
requirement: The app implements code obfuscation.

title: Resource Obfuscation Not Implemented
requirement: The app applies resource obfuscation to hinder reverse engineering.

title: Debug Artifacts Not Removed
requirement: The app does not contain debug artifacts.

title: No Application-Level Payload Encryption
requirement: The app applies application-level payload encryption in addition to transport-layer encryption.

title: Debug Mechanisms Not Disabled
requirement: The app disables debug mechanisms.

title: Debugger Detection Not Implemented
requirement: The app detects debugger attachment at runtime and responds to protect sensitive operations.

title: Dynamic Analysis Tools Detection Not Implemented
requirement: The app detects dynamic analysis tools and responds to protect sensitive operations.

title: Sensitive Data Stored Unencrypted in Private Storage
requirement: The app encrypts sensitive data stored in private storage.

title: Sensitive Data Stored Unencrypted Outside of Private Storage
requirement: The app encrypts sensitive data stored outside of private storage.

title: Cryptographic Keys Stored Outside of Platform Keystore
requirement: The app stores cryptographic keys inside the platform-provided secure keystore.

title: Sensitive Data Hardcoded in the App Package
requirement: The app does not hardcode sensitive data in the application package.

title: Insertion of Sensitive Data into Logs
requirement: The app excludes sensitive data from application logs.

title: Sensitive Data Not Excluded From Backup
requirement: The app excludes sensitive data from backups.
